mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% per annum indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase exceeding 4.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and retail sales (RSAFS) below 600,000 million dollars indicates labor market deterioration and weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and RSAFS < 600000.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) combined with elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates aggressive monetary policy during inflationary pressures, reducing equity attractiveness and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lower economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1700.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 620,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 620000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 index points indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% combined with payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 144,000 thousand persons signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS < 144000.
